customer_text: Where is my package? I want to track my delivery.
support_response: We'd be happy to help. You can track your package and view delivery status from Your Orders.

customer_text: My order still hasn't arrived and it was supposed to be delivered yesterday.
support_response: Sorry your order is delayed. Please check the latest delivery estimate in Your Orders.

customer_text: Can you help me track my shipment?
support_response: Absolutely. Open Your Orders and select the order to view tracking information.

customer_text: The package says delivered but I can't find it.
support_response: Please check the delivery location and any carrier delivery notes. If it is still missing, contact support for further help.

customer_text: I was charged twice on my card this month, help!
support_response: I'm sorry about the duplicate charge. Please contact support so the payment can be reviewed.

customer_text: Why did I get charged a second time for the same order?
support_response: We can help investigate duplicate charges. Please contact support with the order details.

customer_text: There is a fee on my order that I don't understand.
support_response: We can review the charge and explain the fee. Please contact support with the order information.

customer_text: My payment was charged but my order is not showing.
support_response: We can help check the payment and order status. Please contact support with the transaction details.

customer_text: I want a refund for this order.
support_response: You can start a return or refund request from Your Orders, subject to the item's return eligibility.

customer_text: How do I return an item?
support_response: Go to Your Orders, select the item, and choose the available return option.

customer_text: Can I get my money back for this purchase?
support_response: Please check the order's return options in Your Orders or contact support if you need further help.

customer_text: I returned my order but haven't received my refund yet.
support_response: Refund timing can vary after a return. Please check the refund status in your order details.

customer_text: My Fire Stick keeps crashing when I open Prime Video.
support_response: Please try restarting the Fire TV device and checking for available software updates.

customer_text: Prime Video keeps showing an error.
support_response: Please restart the app and device, and check that the latest app version is installed.

customer_text: Alexa is not responding to me.
support_response: Please check that the device has power and network connectivity, then restart the device.

customer_text: My Kindle is frozen and won't respond.
support_response: Please restart the Kindle and install any available software updates.

customer_text: I can't log into my Amazon account.
support_response: Please use the account recovery flow to reset your password and regain access.

customer_text: I forgot my password. How can I reset it?
support_response: Use the password assistance page to reset your Amazon account password.

customer_text: My account is locked.
support_response: Please use the account recovery and verification steps to restore access.

customer_text: I think someone hacked my account.
support_response: Please secure the account immediately by changing your password and contacting support.

customer_text: What does Amazon Prime include?
support_response: Prime includes a range of shipping, streaming and other member benefits depending on your region and plan.

customer_text: How can I cancel Prime?
support_response: You can manage or cancel your Prime membership from the Prime membership settings page.

customer_text: How much is Prime membership?
support_response: Prime pricing varies by plan and region. Check your Amazon Prime membership page for current pricing.

customer_text: What is the return policy?
support_response: Return eligibility depends on the product and seller. Check the return information in Your Orders.

customer_text: Can you help me change my delivery address?
support_response: Address changes depend on the order status. Open Your Orders to see whether the address can still be changed.

customer_text: Where can I see my order history?
support_response: Open Your Orders from your Amazon account to view your previous purchases.

customer_text: My gift card isn't working.
support_response: Please check the gift card balance and redemption details, or contact support for further assistance.

customer_text: Why isn't my promo code applying?
support_response: Please review the promotion's eligibility and terms to confirm that your order qualifies.

customer_text: How do I update my payment method?
support_response: You can manage saved payment methods from the Payment Options section of your Amazon account.

customer_text: My order was cancelled unexpectedly.
support_response: Please check the order details and cancellation notice for the reason and available next steps.

customer_text: Can I change an item after placing the order?
support_response: Changes may be possible before the order enters shipping. Check Your Orders for available options.

customer_text: I need help with my Amazon order.
support_response: We'd be happy to help. Open Your Orders and select the relevant order for available support options.
